title: PublishRequest
$comment: v1.0.0 — normalized over TikTok Content Posting API / Meta Graph / X API v2 drivers. The idempotency_key IN the contract is what makes double-posting structurally impossible (ADR D8): drivers must check publish_records for a completed row with this key before any platform call. Note: Maistro uses 'x'; SamsungSentiment data uses 'twitter' — the sentiment adapter maps at the boundary.

approval_id.$comment: Hard precondition — must reference an unrevoked 'approved' decision for content_version_id.
